purpose: Explain/stress-test the strong Aim1B cross-cell fingerprint without increasing model complexity.

tests.gene_disjoint: Train on uniquely MANE-annotated training loci; evaluate only held-out loci whose MANE gene is absent from training.
tests.region: Region-only cross-cell score plus fixed 5-mer score evaluated within held-out transcript regions.
tests.confidence: Repeat transfer after retaining calls at or above 50% and 75% within-assay/cell source-signal ranks.
tests.writer_sequence: Repeat after removing PUS7-like UNUAR and strict USUAG contexts.
tests.positional_effects: Report -2/-1/+1/+2 base log-odds effects independently in HEK293T/HeLa.

known_mechanism_exclusion_by_design: Single-U primary loci contain no +/-1 U, so the main Aim1B result cannot be directly driven by ELAP's +1U preference, consecutive-U localization ambiguity, or canonical local TRUB1 GUΨCN context.
